# models

Model definitions.

| Module | What it does |
|---|---|
| [baseline.py](baseline.py) | Fixed-hyperparameter baseline models (Blueprint §3.5) -- deliberately NO tuning (§3.1). |
| [calibration.py](calibration.py) | Probability calibration (Blueprint §3.6): Platt (sigmoid) and isotonic, fit only on a purged/embargoed calibration slice. |
| [ensemble.py](ensemble.py) | Champion/challenger stack (Blueprint §3.5): base models -> out-of-fold meta-model -> calibrator. |
| [ranges.py](ranges.py) | Expected-move ranges: the h-day log return divided by a volatility forecast has a roughly stable distribution, so its past quantiles (only outcomes already realised) turn a forecast into a calibrated range. |
| [selective.py](selective.py) | Selective prediction / abstention (Blueprint §3.6-3.7): trade only when confident. |
| [volatility.py](volatility.py) | Volatility models: a linear HAR benchmark, shallow gradient boosting and their equal-weight blend. |
